opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: For early career researchers, with a research record but who have not yet held a full-time permanent academic post, to undertake a significant piece of publishable work.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Centenary Doctoral Scholarships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: For UK universities to fund up to 30 Leverhulme Doctoral Scholarships in an interdisciplinary priority research area for that institution.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: For experienced researchers, particularly those who are or have been prevented by routine duties from completing a programme of original research.

opportunities.title: Research Project Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: For researchers based at universities or institutions of higher education, to undertake an innovative and original research project.

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: For UK institutions to invite an eminent senior professor from overseas, to bring genuinely novel expertise and enhance the skills and knowledge of academic staff and students in an underrepresented area of research, within the UK.
